ratings_why.fun: A good climb: cheap aged buy-backs early, steady Contraband growth mid-game, and Grisel, Wenna and the Auctioneer stacking late, with a hold-or-run choice every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 over 7 because no tribe today treats the shop itself as its resource: a second shelf of any tribe's units that ages, fights through Grisel and steals enemy copies plays unlike anything in the lobby.

verdict_why: v3 made the unclear cards readable; what remains is numbers for the owner, and more passes would only change it, not improve it.

points.text: The hold lane's Tier 2-3 growth sits on the shelf, not the board, so its early fights depend on spending 2 gold a turn to buy back. Worth watching in a playtest that the early curve doesn't dip.
Tibby Slick has no tie to the shelf. If its redirected hit kills the neighbour, it could put a plain copy in your Customs House, an early taste of Corporal Rufa.
Gammer Eelby pays you to sell the Contraband the otter lane is growing. Paying for selling Created Contraband only (Rufa's steals, Discovers) would point it at the spare goods instead.
With two Seize sources, Seize-then-buy-back at 2 beats buying at 3 almost every time, so the shop's own Buy fades. That is the hook, but the owner may want the buy-back price to rise with tier.
Auctioneer Ardley is the tribe's only geometric growth (about x1.5 a turn on a Contraband board, x2 golden). The designer's 'a quarter' fallback is the right dial if it runs away.

standouts.why: Grisel turns the shelf into an army at Start of Combat; it's the capstone the whole hold lane is built to reach.
Bond Clerk makes holding a real choice at Tier 2: goods left on the shelf get better every turn.
Corporal Rufa turns fights into stock by stealing copies of what it kills, a fresh link from combat back to the shop.

weakest.why: Tibby Slick is a fine tempo body but ignores the tribe's mechanic.
Gammer Eelby's gold works against the lane that grows Contraband.
Pebble Jack is a plain small scaler that Creel-Bottom Kit and Oilskin Molly outclass soon after.

flags.note: Half (golden: all) of a unit's stats to every Contraband unit each turn grows the board geometrically; you lose a unit each turn, which slows it.
Shelf copies count toward triples and Seizing costs nothing, so triples can come for 0 gold.
Shelved Wenna or Sentry copies fire their own Start of Combat text, so Grisel with Wenna and Nan stacks well above the Tier 6 target; it's in-fight only and limited by empty slots.
